design: Use the largest connected pure-left-arm sleeve component from the licensed MakeHuman jacket and unchanged V18 Basis geometry as a source surface. First perform one built-in QuadriFlow source-topology study, preserve source boundary, then transfer original UV/material provenance and current target skin weights by actual source-surface correspondence. No cylinder, cap, skin hiding or failed V19/V20 geometry. Preserve all other garment geometry, FPS skin/rig/gun and camera. Automatic topology is an authoring candidate, not final cloth shape approval.
gates: source patch is a connected component of actual licensed clothing, with original polygon/UV and boundary evidence
one deterministic built-in remesh with frozen target400faces, boundary preservation and seed0; no parameter grid
source correspondence, UV/material attribution, finite normalized weights and deviation reported
open cuff/armhole boundary and connection to unchanged garment must be verified before assembly
nonmanifold, degenerates, slivers, source-shape deviation and actual posed skin crossings evaluated
six views and intermediate poses are required for assembly acceptance; source-topology study alone cannot publish
